name: iskra-desktop
description: Iskra: voice and text chat for friends, on servers you own

scripts.test: tsc -p . && node --test dist/launch.test.js dist/platform.test.js dist/restore.test.js dist/games.test.js dist/hotkeys.test.js dist/i18n.test.js dist/passkeys.test.js dist/tailscale.test.js dist/pageRules.test.js dist/saveStreams.test.js dist/digitalocean.test.js dist/doOAuth.test.js dist/title.test.js dist/popouts.test.js dist/restartMarker.test.js dist/testMode.test.js dist/capture.test.js dist/quit.test.js dist/updateCheck.test.js dist/notices.test.js dist/p2p/keys.test.js dist/p2p/proxy.test.js dist/p2p/network.test.js dist/p2p/hostTunnel.test.js dist/p2p/webrtcPolicy.test.js dist/p2p/tunnel.test.js dist/p2p/sidecar.test.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && cross-env ISKRA_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.dist: npm --prefix ../client run build && node scripts/prepare-server.mjs win-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:unsigned: npm --prefix ../client run build && cross-env ISKRA_UNSIGNED=1 node scripts/prepare-server.mjs win-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable nsis --publish never -c.win.signtoolOptions.sign=./scripts/no-sign.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm --prefix ../client run build && node scripts/prepare-server.mjs linux-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm --prefix ../client run build && node scripts/prepare-server.mjs osx-arm64 osx-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac-arm64: npm --prefix ../client run build && node scripts/prepare-server.mjs osx-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac-x64: npm --prefix ../client run build && node scripts/prepare-server.mjs osx-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never

linux.synopsis: Voice and text chat for friends, on servers you own

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Iskra uses your microphone when you talk in voice channels.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Iskra uses your camera when you turn on video in a voice channel.
